name: select-38
description: Phone number field with a country dialing code select in front of the input.

files.content: import { ButtonGroup } from "@workspace/ui/components/button-group" import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel, } from "@workspace/ui/components/field" import { Input } from "@workspace/ui/components/input" import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, } from "@workspace/ui/components/select" const codes = [ { label: "+1", value: "us", country: "United States" }, { label: "+44", value: "uk", country: "United Kingdom" }, { label: "+49", value: "de", country: "Germany" }, { label: "+61", value: "au", country: "Australia" }, { label: "+81", value: "jp", country: "Japan" }, ] export default function PhoneCountryCodeSelect() { return ( Phone number We'll text a code to verify this number. ) }
